evidence.detail: POST /api/doorprize only records the winner sent by pdbot; selection logic is not in this repo
set_doorprize() simply inserts the provided winner into the doorprize table — no eligibility logic here
No door-prize selection/eligibility code found anywhere in this repository; the bug is in the PDBot codebase

triage.notes: The door prize candidate selection (filtering out players who made top 8 vs. those who dropped before top 8) lives in the PDBot project, not in penny-dreadful-tools. The fix needs to happen there.
